chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Sparks as road manager, Earl Roberts and booking themselves
summary: Sparks managed the road; later only Earl Roberts managed them, and otherwise they booked themselves.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: The funny thing about it, Fred Sparks (phonetic spelling), a great big fat guy used to always talk about one of these days a strong wind would blow him over and he'll never get up no more, and he outlived Fred many, many, many years.
Didn't he quit playing to become the manager?
He was a road manager, when he had his band.
You never had--after you left Texas--you didn't have another manager until that guy up in New England, Earl Roberts.
I don't know of any other.
You guys were really booking yourselves.
